#!/bin/sh # EA: ARD / Remote Management status # 12-14: reports service state + naprivs perms (old behavior) # 15+: perms via kickstart/naprivs no longer honored; reports service state only
major=$(sw_vers -productVersion | awk -F '.' '{print $1}')
if [ "$major" -lt 12 ] 2>/dev/null; then echo "<result>Pre-12</result>" exit 0 fi
# Service state: com.apple.screensharing is loaded in the system domain # when Remote Management or Screen Sharing is enabled (works 12 through 26) if launchctl print system/com.apple.screensharing >/dev/null 2>&1; then rd="On" else rd="Off" fi
if [ "$major" -ge 15 ]; then # naprivs is written but ignored by the service on 15+; don't report it echo "<result>${rd}. MDM-managed (all users).</result>" exit 0 fi
# 12-14: naprivs still meaningful perms=$(dscl . -list /Users dsAttrTypeNative:naprivs 2>/dev/null | grep -w ADMINUSERNAME | awk '{print $1}') if [ "$perms" = "ADMINUSERNAME" ]; then echo "<result>${rd}. Set.</result>" else echo "<result>${rd}. None.</result>" fi
